return_contract.not_attempted_rule: when benchmark_lease_acquisition_attempted is false, no lease artifact is requested, copied, or awaited
return_contract.attempted_rule: an acquisition attempt requires an independently transferred and verified lease receipt
return_contract.cleanup_rule: the same local rehearsal transaction validates and removes only its exact factorization-v2 child before response emission, proves absence, and places the mandatory cleanup receipt in the preflighted final frame; no SSH/SCP cleanup exists
return_contract.data_plane: one framed stdout stream returns a compact deterministic tar+gzip archive with full artifact hash index; the declaration carries archive hash/size/count plus member-count and full-inventory digest before ordered chunks
return_contract.maximum_expected_run_archive_justificati: Factorization V2 compaction retains raw runner/stage JSONL, correctness/resource/counter records and cryptographic indexes, while omitting the redundant representative request payload, repeated raw process tables, full nm output, build text, and duplicated command stdout/stderr; the 512 KiB expected bound must be proven by deterministic local archive fixtures and the sole rehearsal
return_contract.transport_timeout_derivation: the 900-second silent operator bound covers two serial builds, 24 untimed correctness encodes, 12 untimed work encodes, and the exact 36-process/180-encode timing inventory using prior approximately 0.94-1.22 second representative evidence plus margin; the 15-second progress bound is over 7x the prior approximately 0.51 second 256 KiB cadence; the 1,800-second absolute bound covers request, operator, stream, and finally
return_contract.incremental_pump: one retained directly-owned SSH Popen uses nonblocking selectors to write framed request chunks while concurrently draining stdout/stderr; REQUEST_WRITE retains request-progress plus absolute bounds until stdin half-close; SILENT_OPERATOR covers the remote build and complete-response preflight; BULK_STREAM starts only after a complete schema-valid size-valid declaration arrives and resets 15 seconds per received byte; FOOTERS separately bounds integrity plus cleanup for 15 seconds; only deadline expiry may stop that retained creation identity
return_contract.online_validation: the remote encodes and checks every frame, control payload, archive byte, footer, and cleanup receipt before writing its first response byte; reject archive above 786432 bytes, any control above 8192 bytes, or total framed stdout greater than or equal to 1048576 bytes; then verify ordered frames/chunks, archive digest, compact full-inventory digest, integrity footer, cleanup-last receipt, raw stream hashes/counts, and exact-child absence before extraction
return_contract.request_direction_validation: a 2097152-byte deterministic payload is streamed only client-to-remote; remote admission checks exact size/SHA-256 and returns only its compact receipt, so request capacity and capped response capacity are independently exercised without performance evidence

process_isolation.raw_comm_semantics: the complete remaining comm field is a nonempty exact opaque process-table string; slashless, slash-bearing, space-bearing, and path-like strings are valid and never filesystem-canonicalized
process_isolation.lexical_basename_semantics: derived only as raw_comm.rsplit('/', 1)[-1], recorded separately, and never resolved, normalized, statted, or checked against the filesystem
process_isolation.conflict_rule: exact frozen raw_comm and/or exact lexical_basename deny-set membership; no substring, prefix, suffix, argv, source, payload, filesystem, or symlink matching
process_isolation.ancestor_rule: the self PID must exist and exact PPID edges must form a complete acyclic chain ending at PID 1; every ancestor requires a well-formed nonempty opaque raw_comm and lexical_basename, but no positive ancestor identity allowlist or filesystem identity match exists
process_isolation.scope_rule: every process row is checked for exact denied raw_comm or lexical_basename membership; arbitrary well-formed non-denied ancestors and nonancestors pass, including slash, spaces, path-like values, and benign lexical collisions
process_isolation.malformed_rule: invalid UTF-8, truncation, malformed PID/PPID/remaining-comm structure, control-bearing or empty raw_comm or lexical basename, duplicate PIDs, self-parent edges, missing ancestor parents, ancestor cycles, non-PID1 ppid0, and absent self PID fail closed
process_isolation.discovery_policy: read-only observation/refusal; raw snapshots are classified in memory and retained as exact SHA-256/byte-count/structural receipts; discovered PIDs never enter signal APIs
process_isolation.refusal_diagnostic: bounded libwebp-backref-cost-specialization-factorization-v2-process-refusal-v1 object in the integrity footer with failure_code, PID, PPID, raw_comm, lexical_basename, is_ancestor, is_conflict, and SHA-256; no argv, environment, source, payload, command, or filesystem identity

selection.xctrace: rejected: v1 never established noninteractive launch permission and prompting cannot be rehearsed safely

build.identity_rule: one optimized recorder-free Mach-O serves B/L/H timing and one separately hashed recorder Mach-O serves untimed work; Apple ld identical-code deduplication is disabled so all six private symbols have distinct addresses; exact private symbols and codegen facts are recorded

protocol.purpose: fresh simultaneous B/L/H causal factorization; never a V16 rerun and never pooled with V16 samples
protocol.lifecycle: one import, one excluded warmup, then four retained coarse-timer encodes per process
protocol.serial_rule: one synchronous directly spawned runner at a time under one exclusive lease; no overlap or retry
protocol.correctness: before timing, exactly two B, two L and two H encodes per case/method (24 total); exact bitstreams, decoded RGB pixels, repeat determinism, immutable inputs, integer costs, ties, update order and traceback must match
protocol.selected_dp_structure: a separate recorder build emits exactly 12 untimed work rows, one per case/method/variant; one selector evaluation per selected DP, no opposite body, B/L exact work equality, common B/L/H algorithm work equality, and H-only append-hint activations are mandatory
protocol.pairing: within each case/method/repetition, retained ordinal 0..3 aligns B, L and H; compute B->L, L->H and B->H as 100*(Y-X)/X for each of 12 paired retained rows per cell and metric
protocol.statistics: for DP total, DP steady and whole encode in every cell/pair report all 12 paired percentages, arithmetic mean, median, sample standard deviation, min/max, sign counts, and deterministic 100000-resample paired bootstrap 95% percentile CI for the mean with seed 0x424c4801; setup is retained and reported but not causal-decision primary
protocol.perturbation: monotonic clocks occur only at whole stages and DP setup/steady/trace/materialize boundaries; no per-PushInterval clock; timed binaries contain no recorder symbols or work counters

acceptance.per_profile: five runner output records, five stage records, four retained records, exact schemas, and zero stderr

work_counters.rules: B and L are exactly equal for all work and have zero hint/pop activity; B/L/H common push/cache/overlap/disjoint/insert/backward/update/pop/live/bitstream work is equal; H differs only in intended append-hint/pop-tail positioning fields, has exact activation, positive hint activity, and zero forward positioning in every active cell

acceptance.repeatability: for each case/method/variant, three retained-total medians have max/min <=2.0 and each major stage-share range <=0.10 absolute
acceptance.timer_accounting: on every successful timed encode DP total.calls == DP setup.calls == DP steady.calls > 0, backend equals the frozen B/L/H launch, setup+steady <= DP total, and DP total+traceback+materialize <= backward refs
acceptance.timer_boundaries: DP total is immediately around exactly one selected DP body including cleanup; setup starts before allocation and ends only after successful CostManagerInit; steady covers only initial literal plus pixel DP loop; traceback and materialization are separately timed; no per-pixel or PushInterval clock
acceptance.build_identity: one recorder-free timed runner serves B/L/H; a distinct recorder runner serves untimed work only; frozen clang/SDK/flags and all six private DP/PushInterval symbols are mandatory
acceptance.resources: AC power, LPM off, no thermal warning, >=4 GiB free memory, >=8 GiB disk, output <=2 GiB, one directly owned child
acceptance.diagnostic_success: all correctness, schema, count, order, hash, resource, work, codegen, repeatability and transport gates pass; this can pass even when production promotion fails
acceptance.production_promotion: H may be proposed only if B->H DP steady and whole-encode mean are negative in all four required cells, each upper 95% bootstrap CI is <=0, no paired row regresses by more than +0.50%, and correctness/work gates pass; otherwise retain diagnostic only

interpretation.quantify: report B->L, L->H and B->H for DP total, DP steady and whole encode separately in every photo/graphic method-4/method-6 cell
interpretation.layout_limit: B->L estimates duplication/code-placement/control-layout cost; L->H estimates the append-hint algorithm within matched always-specialized structure; B->H is the simultaneous total boundary. Coarse timers plus work/codegen may still leave interaction unresolved.
interpretation.classification: per cell and metric, classify layout-dominant when abs(B->L) >= 0.60*abs(B->H) and abs(L->H) < 0.60*abs(B->H); hint-dominant uses the symmetric rule; opposite-signed components or neither rule are interaction/mixed; abs(B->H)<0.10% is indeterminate-small
interpretation.close_family: diagnostic validity and production promotion are separate decisions; do not weaken thresholds after results
interpretation.next_stage: Phase 3 alone decides consequence or one independently gated next lead
interpretation.follow_up: a later evaluator may propose one new gated experiment but cannot implement it from this evidence
interpretation.no_pooling: no old samples, call-stack claims, relabeling, thresholds, graphic-only path, Metal, or CUDA
